newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai sugar output reaches 1.43 mln tonnes so far.
newsitem.headline: Thai sugar output reaches 1.43 mln tonnes so far.

text.p: Thailand produced 1.43 million tonnes of sugar since the crushing season started in late November, industry ministry sources said on Monday.

Based on data gathered as of January 16, the 46 registered mills in the country crushed 15.49 tonnes of sugar cane and produced 512,143 tonnes of white sugar and 921,717 tonnes of raw, they told Reuters.
Sugar output rose 47 percent from last week when production was recorded at 969,852 tonnes on January 8, the sources said.

The yield also improved to 92.54 kg of sugar per tonne of sugar cane from 88.48 kg last week. But this is below the government-targeted yield of around 103-104 kg per tonne for the 1996/97 crushing season.
Thailand's Sugar Boards expect 60.32 million tonnes of sugarcane to be crushed this season for a projected total production of 6.28 million tonnes tel quel of sugar.
Molasses production rose to 564,296 tonnes from 369,273 tonnes as of January 8 with yield at 36.42 kg per tonne, the sources said. -- Bangkok newsroom (662) 652-0642
